title: Two parties fight with lathis outside a party office
situation: While students protest at Dak Bungalow crossing, ruling-party workers march to gherao the opposition party office; both sides allegedly use lathis and stones; each calls it a pre-planned conspiracy by the other.

lines.text: the law-and-order situation deteriorated after some protesters attempted to move forward.
lines.speaker: SDPO Komal Meena

lines.text: democratic voices could not be silenced through the arrogance of power
lines.speaker: Bihar Congress president

lines.text: A "pre-planned attempt to create unrest", a "deliberate conspiracy".
lines.speaker: BJP leaders

buildThis.situation: At 14:30 RUP and LJM workers start fighting over who owns the stage; students in between get blamed, and the ticker headline depends on who filmed first.
